node.statement: Final datum and raw-call assembly. Put delta=C_delta*t. Nodes 1.3-1.6 imply that P_U^R,P_j^R are delta-projections, ||P_U^R+P_j^R-I_{A_R}||=0<=delta, T is an extended delta-isomorphism M_|U|->S^{A_R}_{P_U^R}, dim S^{A_R}_{P_j^R}=1, and S^{A_R}_{P_U^R,P_j^R} is nonzero. Thus these objects satisfy every clause of def-extcb-datum in the extended epsilon_{A_R}-C*-algebra A_R. Its total error is e=delta+epsilon_{A_R}<=(C_delta+2*C_ca)t<=C_s2*t. Record the literal Stage-2 tag, the supplied U-reset state, source M_|U|, target corner S^{A_R}_{P_U^R}, base scale t, post-helper datum scale e, output T with fixed amplifications (I_n tensor T), target defect epsilon_{A_R}, and raw defect delta; these are exactly the fields of def-maincb-raw-call, so this is the explicit Stage-2 raw-call closed EXT-CB datum asserted at node 1.
